items.title: OpenShot 4.0: Record, Edit, and Color Like Never Before
items.summary: OpenShot 4.0 introduces significant enhancements in video recording, editing, and color grading capabilities, making it a powerful tool for creators. Developers and engineers should explore these new features to leverage OpenShot for advanced multimedia projects.

items.title: uv: Deduplicate all files in the wheel cache
items.summary: A recent pull request in the 'uv' project introduces functionality to deduplicate files in the wheel cache, optimizing storage and improving performance. This enhancement is significant for developers managing large Python environments.
